topics.title: Rocket stage heads for the moon
topics.summary: Astronomers are tracking a discarded SpaceX rocket stage expected to hit the moon on August 5, creating a small crater and a brief observation chance for telescopes.
topics.discussionPrompt: If old space hardware makes a moon crater, is that a useful science moment, a littering problem, or somehow both?

topics.title: Ariana Grande plans a quieter stretch
topics.summary: Ariana Grande is stepping back from public visibility after her tour and has withdrawn from a planned London musical, while producers say the show will continue with new casting.
topics.discussionPrompt: When someone famous says they need less spotlight, do you think fans usually understand, or does curiosity just get louder?

topics.title: Canada rolls out August rule changes
topics.summary: New Canadian rules this month affect student support, foreign-influence transparency, cosmetic labels, real-time banking payments and other everyday systems for residents and newcomers.
topics.discussionPrompt: Which quiet rule change would you actually notice first: faster payments, clearer labels, school funding, or something nobody reads until it matters?

topics.title: Entertainment week gets busy
topics.summary: The week ahead brings new films, festivals, music releases, streaming premieres and stage events, giving culture fans a crowded menu of choices across several formats.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a week is packed with movies, music, games and shows, do you chase the biggest release or look for the weird little surprise?
